Our honest read: it's realistic to sell more pianos by New Year, but the number is the owner's call, not ours. We have no sales baseline, chat data or margin data yet, so "+10" is a placeholder. Five points:

1. **Organic reach takes time.** It is not a switch, especially for an item costing 200 000 to 2 000 000 ₸ with a research phase of several weeks. So we start now, use the first two weeks to find out what works, and save direct selling for the last 10 days.

Piano-selection review channels have a CIS audience: «Pianoby - LIVE» has 65 100 followers and a 3 300 median; «PIANOBY» has 6 740 followers and a 1 200 median. We have channel metadata only. Their videos and comments have not been analysed yet, and those comments are the best substitute for customer language in this category.

An 'adult beginner' identity exists in the category: «Георгий Морев. Уроки гитары для взрослых» has 99 300 followers and an 8 950 median, the highest median among the peers. It is a guitar channel, so applying this to pianos is an assumption.

EVIDENCE GAP: there are no customer-voice atoms. No WhatsApp chats; no 2GIS, Google or Yandex reviews were fetched; Instagram blocked the crawl; peer comments were not scraped; autocomplete was not crawled. The language bank is empty, and no insight passes C4 test 1 (Evidenced) on customer sources. Every customer-side tension below is a hypothesis.

New Year (2026-12-31) is the boss's deadline and probably a gift moment for a big family purchase. School winter break starts in late December. The push window is Dec 21–31, and gift-moment content should be pre-shot 2–3 weeks ahead (from about Dec 1). This comes from the boss's request plus the static calendar, with no client data on gift buying.

The music-school term has been running since September. Pupils who started this autumn are likely to need a home instrument to practise on, so October to December is a natural window for parents to buy.
evidence.source: static calendar; cross-client archetype (no client data)

evidence.claim: Hypothesis: parents hesitate because they fear the child will quit, and because they rely on the teacher's one-line advice («нужно с молоточковой механикой», «акустика лучше»). This needs checking against the WhatsApp chat sample.

The fetched piano properties (px770_specs and ap270_specs; the properties in products_batch001.json are similar) cover only keys, polyphony, colour, bench, Bluetooth, DSP and auto-accompaniment. Key action (weighted or hammer), headphone outputs, weight, dimensions and stand or pedal contents are missing. Until we fetch them, we cannot claim anything about touch, silent practice, space or delivery weight.

Hypothesis: many Astana families live in apartments, so practising without disturbing neighbours or a sleeping sibling is a reason to choose a digital piano with headphones. We have no client data on this, and headphone outputs per model are unverified (EV27).

Casio AP-300 is listed in several finishes (BK, WE, BN, GB) at the same 754 990 ₸. White (WE) has the most stock (4 units) and BN is out of stock. The finish is a real choice at no extra cost, which may matter if the piano stands where guests see it.

The shop's WhatsApp is +7 701 0987734. Calls are Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00 and Sat 10:00–17:00 (fact hours). WhatsApp reply time and the inquiry-to-order rate are unknown, so the chat funnel cannot be computed yet.
A pickup reservation holds for 3 working days and can be extended on request. This helps with gift timing, for example reserving a model and collecting it before the holiday.

Likely filmable realities, to be confirmed by the worker reality scan: close-up of hands on keys with the phone ≤30 cm from the speaker; two pianos side by side playing the same phrase; headphones being plugged in (if the model has an output); the spec label or card; the sustain pedal; a packed piano box at pickup; the street entrance and the showroom floor.
evidence.source: inferred from EV20 and product types; reality scan not yet done

evidence.claim: The site offers to compensate delivery costs in exchange for a review or video. This may break platform rules on incentivised reviews. We will not use or promote it, and we flag it to the owner.

Category convention, seen on Muzzone's own channel and catalogue: a model-name title, a horizontal demo with a player and no buyer question, and product cards that list specs («Полифония: 192», «Bluetooth: N», «Банкетка: Нет») without explaining them (see also products_batch001.json, L005, L006). Peer short-form conventions have not been scanned yet.

Cross-client learnings L001 and L003 (measured on peer Shorts, not on this client) show that text-based priors are close to useless for Shorts: Spearman 0.11 overall and 0.07 for retail. All insight and idea scores below are weak priors, not forecasts. Labelled an assumption because the source is outside the client ledger.

insights.insight: RANK 1, category + business source, PROVISIONAL. Parents and adult beginners want a piano that will be 'enough' for years, because they are spending hundreds of thousands of ₸. But every listing says 88 keys while in-stock prices run from 200 720 to 2 075 617 ₸, and the product cards list jargon instead of differences a buyer can hear. So they delay, or default to the cheapest or most familiar listing. Customer voice: «Везде 88 клавиш — за что тогда платить в три раза больше?» Scores E1 / I2 / B3 / S2 / D2 / T2 = 12. Test 1 (Evidenced) FAILS on customer sources: we have only catalogue and channel data. Tests 2 to 4 likely pass. Test 5 (Answerable) passes only partly: the PX-770 vs AP-270 pair is fully in the ledger, and other models need ledger entries first.
insights.tension: Price vs risk. The category convention (identical spec cards, demos with no buyer question) vs what buyers need (to hear what the extra money buys).
insights.who_feels_it: Buyers in Astana and across RK who compare piano listings online before writing to a shop: mainly parents of music-school pupils and adult beginners. This audience is assumed; verify it in chats.
insights.content_reality: Two in-stock pianos side by side, the same short phrase played on each, phone ≤30 cm from the speaker. The price is spoken or captioned inside the story, never shown as a slide. Engines: E09 blind test («Угадайте, где дороже»); E08 price anatomy (PX-770 vs AP-270: 38 973 ₸ difference, polyphony 128 vs 192); E20 three real price tiers; E11 sorter. Prices for Estrada EDP-220BK, PX-S1100BK and AP-300WE need ledger entries (EV05) before they appear in content.

insights.insight: RANK 2, culture / moment source, PROVISIONAL. Families who choose a piano as the New Year present want it to arrive on time and stay a surprise, because it is the year's big family gift. But it is a heavy, bulky item bought in the busiest weeks, and delivery cut-offs are not published. So they postpone to «после праздников» or buy something smaller. Customer voice: «Хочу подарить к Новому году — а как его привезти, чтобы успели и ребёнок не увидел?» Scores E1 / I3 / B3 / S2 / D1 / T2 = 12. Test 1 fails: the only evidence is the calendar and the boss's request. Tests 3 to 5 pass for free delivery and the 3-day reserve, but any timing claim is blocked until the owner answers Q3.
insights.tension: Time vs certainty: the wish for a perfect surprise vs the logistics of a 20+ kg box at peak season.
insights.who_feels_it: Parents and relatives buying a gift in December, both in Astana and in the regions (free ground delivery across RK over 100 000 ₸).
insights.content_reality: A packed piano box at pickup; a 'what happens after you write' chain (code word → model → reserve for 3 working days → pickup or free RK delivery); hands tying a bow on the box if the shop has one (shop's own props only). Engines: E12 POV («POV: подарок весом с холодильник надо спрятать до 31-го»), E21, E05, E20 gift tiers. Pre-shoot from about Dec 1. No «успеем к Новому году» claim without the owner's cut-off dates (Q3).

insights.insight: RANK 3, category + business source, PROVISIONAL. Buyers read «Полифония 128 / 192», «Bluetooth: N», «Банкетка: Нет» and cannot translate that into 'is this fine for my child's practice?'. They also miss hidden extras: for example, the bench is not in the box for the PX-770 or AP-270. So they lean on a teacher's one-liner or a brand name. Customer voice: «Полифония 192 — это мне вообще надо? И банкетку отдельно покупать?» Scores E1 / I1 / B3 / S2 / D2 / T2 = 11.
insights.tension: Category convention vs need: spec sheets are written for insiders but bought by non-musicians who fear looking clueless («не разбираюсь, но не хочу переплатить»).
insights.who_feels_it: First-time piano buyers who are not musicians: parents and gift buyers.
insights.content_reality: A finger points at the spec line on the screen or price tag, then a close-up demo on the keys. Engines: E06 «3 вещи проверить перед покупкой цифрового пианино» (one of them: is the bench included? per the ledger); E05 «Вопрос из WhatsApp»; E11. Every spec explanation needs a derived fact. A polyphony demo must not claim an audible difference we have not verified. Key-action and headphone specs must be fetched first (EV27). Strong save driver, and the same material doubles as YouTube search content (EV13).

insights.insight: RANK 4, customer source (hypothesis only), PROVISIONAL. Parents whose child has just started music school want a home instrument, because the teacher expects daily practice. But they fear spending 200 000 to 750 000 ₸ and then the child quitting in six months. So they buy a cheap keyboard, borrow one, or delay. Customer voice: «А если через полгода бросит — зачем мне пианино за полмиллиона?» Scores E1 / I3 / B3 / S1 / D1 / T1 = 10. Test 5 is weak: there are no rental, trade-in or instalment facts, and returns require the item to be unused (EV10). So we can show the entry tier and help people choose, but we cannot take the risk off them.
insights.tension: Price vs risk; the parent's ideal (a musical child) vs reality (an uncertain commitment).
insights.who_feels_it: Parents of first- and second-year music-school pupils in Astana.
insights.content_reality: No children on camera (the default). Instead: adult hands on the keys of the cheapest in-stock model vs a mid-tier model; a tier sorter («первый год / если не бросил / на годы»); answers to WhatsApp questions. Engines: E11, E20, E05, and E22 only with owner permission for a real story. Non-marketing flag for the owner: an instalment, trade-in or rental option would resolve this tension, but only if the owner chooses to offer one. We will not invent one.

insights.insight: WILDCARD, culture source, low evidence and high showability. Astana families in apartments want the child to practise every day, but they dread neighbours knocking or a sibling waking up. That makes silent practice a hidden job a digital piano does. Customer voice: «Ей заниматься каждый день, а соседи уже стучат по батарее.» Scores E0 / I2 / B2 / S3 / D2 / T1 = 10. T rises to 2 once headphone outputs per model are in the ledger.
insights.tension: Private need vs social judgement: wanting daily practice vs not wanting to be the noisy neighbours.
insights.who_feels_it: Parents in apartments, and adult beginners who practise in the evening.
insights.content_reality: A 2-second mechanism, loopable: the same chord played loud, then headphones plugged in, then silence in the room (close sound, phone ≤30 cm). Engines: E04, E12 POV («POV: 22:00, соседи спят, а у неё гаммы»), E16 local truth. Blocked until headphone output is confirmed per model (EV27).

insights.insight: HELD, business source; use it for the trust shelf and WhatsApp replies, not for reach. Someone about to spend 600 000 ₸ or more wants to know who fixes the piano if it breaks. Casio service is only in Almaty, and a site-wide «Финальная распродажа» of 535 items can read as 'the shop is closing'. Customer voice: «А если сломается через год — куда я его повезу? Вы вообще будете работать?» Scores E1 / I2 / B2 / S1 / D2 / T1 = 9.
insights.tension: Price vs risk; what the store signals («финальная распродажа») vs the trust needed for a purchase meant to last years.
insights.who_feels_it: Buyers of mid-range and premium models (Casio AP-300, Kurzweil CUP, Gewa) who are close to buying.
insights.content_reality: An honest E05 answer card («Гарантия минимум 12 месяцев; у Casio — 2 года, сервис в Алматы») plus a 'how the warranty works' item on the pinned trust shelf. Non-marketing flag: what «Финальная распродажа» means (Q2) decides whether any warranty content is credible. If the store is closing, after-sales claims are paused.

insights.insight: HELD; the belief's truth is unknown, so T=0 and it is excluded from claim-bearing ideas. Myth: «Цифровое пианино — не настоящее, педагог не примет». The ledger does not say which models have a weighted or hammer action, so we cannot 'bust' the myth. For now it can be used only in empathy or recognition content with no claim, and it can be reactivated once key-action specs are fetched. Customer voice: «Педагог сказал — только с молоточковой механикой, а я не понимаю, какая где.» Scores E0 / I2 / B2 / S2 / D1 / T0 = 7.
insights.tension: Belief vs truth (a category myth), plus deference to the teacher.
insights.who_feels_it: Parents whose child's teacher has an opinion on digital vs acoustic pianos.
insights.content_reality: After the spec fetch: close-up of key travel on two models (E01 / E09). Until then: nothing.

insights.insight: HELD, identity source. Adults who always wanted to play want a piano for themselves, but they fear it is 'too late' or self-indulgent, so they keep postponing. Customer voice: «Мне 35 — не поздно себе пианино покупать?» Peers show an adult-learner audience exists, but only for guitar. Muzzone's own piano lessons decayed to 0.14× median, so lessons are not the route to this audience. Scores E1 / I2 / B1 / S1 / D2 / T1 = 8.
insights.tension: Self-image vs behaviour; desire vs the social judgement of 'playing at your age'.
insights.who_feels_it: Adult beginners, 25–50, buying for themselves.
insights.content_reality: Adult hands, a first chord, POV text. Engines: E12, and E11 with a 'for an adult beginner' profile inside the sorter. Re-rank after the chat sample.

insights.insight: HELD, backup wildcard, culture source. For many families a piano is also furniture in the room where guests sit, so the finish matters as much as the sound. They want it to look like an instrument, not a keyboard on a stool. Casio AP-300 comes in several finishes at the same 754 990 ₸, and the white one has the most stock. Customer voice: «Чтобы в зале стояло красиво, а не как синтезатор на табуретке.» Scores E0 / I1 / B2 / S3 / D2 / T2 = 10.
insights.tension: Private preference vs social judgement (guests in the living room); the cabinet piano vs the portable look.
insights.who_feels_it: Gift buyers and families furnishing a living room.
insights.content_reality: The same model in different finishes in the showroom, or a cabinet model next to a slim one, with an E23 vote: «Белое или чёрное?». Prices need ledger entries first. Keep in reserve in case INS5 stays blocked by the spec fetch.

insights.insight: REJECTED: «Люди хотят хороший звук и качество».
insights.tension: Nothing specific: no evidence-backed tension, and the evidence gap (EV23) means it is not even grounded in customer words.
insights.who_feels_it: n/a

insights.tension: The only tension would be invented urgency.

insights.tension: Not a buyer tension.

insights.tension: No purchase tension.

output.name: «Одна фраза»: услышьте, за что платите (Muzzone, digital pianos to 31.12.2026)
output.why_this_wins:
Nothing here is a forecast. L001 shows short-form text judging is barely above chance (ρ 0.07 for retail), so this design is only a better-built set of shots on goal. Why it is the right bet anyway:

1. **Insight first.** It dramatises the top-ranked tension (INS1, price vs risk: «Везде 88 клавиш — за что платить больше?»). It does this with a reality only this shop has: physical in-stock pianos in Astana that can be played side by side. A competitor's logo would not fit unchanged.

2. **It fixes our known failure mode.** L006 says demos without a buyer question underperform, so every demo here is tied to a money question. L005 says price slides are useless, so prices appear only inside A/B, anatomy and tier stories.

3. **Stop and watch are built in.** Sound starts in frame 1 and the loop is open («слышно?»). The payoff is a verdict-free A/B that invites expert comments, and those comments feed reply videos (an E19 follow-up).

4. **It is cheap and reusable.** One 16.9-minute shoot feeds 7 bodies plus the WA Status cut and YouTube re-cuts, and it leaves 3 minutes of worker budget for code logging.

5. **Honesty is the trust device in a high-ticket category.** We disclose that Casio service is only in Almaty and spell out the real 14-day return conditions. «Финальная распродажа» may be eroding trust, and this counters it without fake urgency.

6. **A search line runs alongside.** On YouTube, model-name and comparison titles measurably win (ρ 0.44, L002/L004). Buyers in a weeks-long research phase can find us there, using the same footage at zero extra worker minutes.

7. **The timeline works.** About 11.5 weeks is enough for Thompson allocation to move slots before the December push. Exploration never drops below 25%, or 15% in the final 10 days.

measurement.success_metric:
Business: digital pianos sold and attributed by 2026-12-31. The target is ASSUMED at +10 attributed sales ≈ 50 coded piano inquiries (assumed 20% inquiry-to-order rate), to be replaced by the owner's Q1 number and the chat-sample conversion rate.

Experiment reward (Thompson): E-score = √(rel_reach × rel_actions), where actions = shares + saves + 0.5 × comments per 1k reach. It is judged at T+7d against the median, and beating it scores 1.

Normalisation:
- YouTube uses the channel's own median per format.
- Instagram and TikTok use the pooled music-retail median, flagged as a hypothesis until there are 10 posts per platform.

The reward switches to coded piano WA inquiries per 1k reach once there are ≥10 coded inquiries in a rolling 4 weeks (expected around 22 Nov; zero codes counts as a failure).

Tail: ≥1 post at ≥5× the median by 2026-12-20 (likely, not guaranteed).
measurement.attribution:
1. One WA code per video and per platform variant (СЛЫШНО1, РАЗНИЦА1, ПРОВЕРКА1, ПОДАРОК1, БЮДЖЕТ1, СЛУХ1, ПЕРВЫЙ1, СЕМЬЯ1; new episodes get new codes), entered through prefilled wa.me links per platform. Whoever answers WhatsApp logs code → model → sold Y/N weekly (≤2 min, inside the worker budget; daily during the push).
2. Weak secondary signal: a weekly site crawl of stock_qty for promoted vs unpromoted piano SKUs (difference-in-differences). It is reported as weak attribution, never as proof.
3. There is no Kaspi-shop attribution, because no Kaspi shop is in the inputs.
4. Uncoded piano inquiries during the campaign are logged as «без кода» and never claimed.

Profile visits and wa.me clicks per 1k reach
Median WA reply time on piano inquiries (guardrail: >60 min)

measurement.review_cadence:
- Per post: T+48h (R1 rescue) and T+7d (reward).
- Weekly, every Monday: posteriors, R4 allocation, ledger TTL re-verification and the shoot card; the boss gets a ≤5-line RU WhatsApp report and the owner one-tap approves the batch on Wednesday.
- Every 2 weeks: R7 funnel diagnosis.
- Checkpoints: 2026-11-02 recalibration after about 10 posts; 2026-11-22 for ≥10 coded inquiries and the SMP lock; 2026-12-20 switch to the push mix; 2026-12-31 final attribution.
- R8 rethink at week 6 (2026-11-22).

decision_rules: Content mix by weekly slots: 50% reach («Одна фраза»), 35% proof and utility focused on in-stock pianos, 15% direct conversion until 2026-12-20, with exploration ≥25%. Then 30/30/40 for 21–31 Dec with exploration ≥15%.

R1 Rescue at T+48h. If rel_hold3 < 0.7, re-cut with the next reserve hook variant and repost ≥72 h later, once only. If hold is fine but rel_completion < 0.7, shorten the next episode and bring the A/B payoff forward.
R2 Iterate. Any post at ≥2× the median on the primary metric gets, within 2 weeks: the same insight with a new engine, the same engine with a new piano pair, and an E19 reply to its best comments.
R3 Scale. A post at ≥3× the median plus ≥1 code gets pinned on Instagram and moved into WA Status. It becomes a paid candidate only if the owner approves a budget and a cost cap.

R4 Allocate every Monday. Slots go in proportion to each arm's share of wins in 1 000 Thompson draws across A1 «Одна фраза», A2 «Перед оплатой», A3 «Вопрос родителя» and A4 «Подарок» (active from Dec 1). Exploration floor 25%, cap 50% per arm. Every arm gets ≥1 slot every 2 weeks until it has 6 posts. Priors come from the rubric (p0 ≈ 0.55–0.60, pseudo-count 4), so the data separates them.
R5 Retire an arm if P(success rate > 0.5) < 0.15 after ≥8 posts. Its data is kept in the pool.
R6 Report honestly. Never say «победитель». Give P(beats median) and an 80% interval. The boss hears «пока похоже, что…».

R7 Funnel check every 2 weeks. If E is rising but codes are flat, fix the conversion layer first: CTA wording, code friction, WA reply time over 60 min, the pinned how-to-order video, trust-shelf highlights. Do this before making more content.

R8 Rethink. If no arm has P > 0.6 and coded inquiries are below 10 by 2026-11-22, rerun step C with the chat sample and customer micro-voice, and propose an owner-approved non-discount offer. Do not make more of the same.

R9 Stock guardrail. Re-check stock on publish day. If a promoted piano SKU shows 0 on the site, pull its conversion posts and swap in an in-stock pair. Never promote any of the 11 out-of-stock piano SKUs.

Truth gates (my call, beyond the method, given the 7-day TTL):
- Every price or difference literal is re-fetched within 7 days before publishing. A mismatch blocks the post.
- TIERS-07, STAKES-11 and FIRSTYEAR-15 publish only after their NEEDED ledger entries exist.
- ANAT-02 publishes without the polyphony-definition line unless the store's wording is approved.

Q2 gate. If «Финальная распродажа» means closure or a brand exit, pause all warranty and after-sales lines (CHECK-03, STATUS-18, trust shelf) and re-plan with the owner. Until it is answered, never use the word «распродажа» or any deadline.

Q3 gate. No «до 31-го», «успеем к Новому году» or reserve-until-date wording unless the owner confirms cut-off and reserve terms. Otherwise December gift slots run gift-tier episodes with pickup and published delivery facts only.
CTA gate. BLIND-01 and STAKES-11 CTAs promise «сыграть самим». If the owner does not confirm showroom try-out by the first publish, the CTA falls back to «расскажем, чем ещё отличаются эти модели».
learning_questions: Does hearing the difference (open A/B listening, A1) beat reading it (spec anatomy and checklist, A2) on saves and codes for a high-ticket item?

Which tension actually moves piano buyers in Astana: price vs what you get (INS1), fear the child quits (INS4), spec confusion (INS3) or the gift moment (INS2)? The chat sample plus coded inquiries decide this, and with it whether the provisional SMP is locked or replaced on 2026-11-22.
Does disclosing the inconvenient truths (Casio service only in Almaty, return only if unused, bench not included) raise or lower coded inquiries and the inquiry-to-order rate?
Is the real bottleneck consideration, as assumed, or conversion (chats dying after the price, slow replies), once we see where piano chats die?
Which price tier do coded inquiries name, and do the most-stocked SKUs (Estrada EDP-220BK, Casio PX-S1100, AP-300WE, Kurzweil CUP) convert in line with their stock?
Does the «Одна фраза» device (same opening and signature phrase) build follows and recognition across episodes, compared with one-off formats?
Which surface yields coded inquiries per 1k reach: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, the YouTube search line, TikTok (if opened) or WA Status to existing contacts?
Do buyers outside Astana write (free RK delivery over 100 000 ₸), and what share of piano sales are delivered vs picked up?
Do expert comments under A/B listens give us material for reply episodes that outperform the originals (an E19 transfer for the library)?

owner_asks.ask: Q2. «Что означает «Финальная распродажа» на сайте — закрытие, уход бренда или сезонная акция со сроком? По умолчанию: в роликах нет слова «распродажа» и дедлайнов, скидки — только как на сайте.»
owner_asks.why: If the store or brand is closing, warranty and after-sales claims, and the whole trust angle, must pause. If there is a real end date, it is the only legitimate source of urgency.

owner_asks.ask: Q3. «До какой даты заказа вы точно доставите пианино к 31 декабря — по Астане и в регионы? И до какой даты можете держать оплаченный подарок в магазине (резерв продлевается по просьбе)? По умолчанию: не обещаем «успеем к Новому году» и «до 31-го».»

owner_asks.ask: Утвердите один раз шаблоны быстрых ответов WhatsApp по кодовым словам и формулировки «для кого какая модель» для роликов с бюджетами. И решение: убрать с сайта компенсацию доставки за отзыв (рекомендуем).
owner_asks.why: Quick replies cut reply time on high-ticket inquiries. The sorter labels are judgment claims that need sign-off. The review-for-compensation offer risks breaking platform rules on incentivised reviews.

owner_asks.ask: Каждую среду: одно нажатие — утвердить ролики недели (ролики с ценами, гарантией или условиями возврата — явное «да»).
owner_asks.why: Nothing posts without approval. Owner access goes through Andrey and Pavel, so a fixed Wednesday slot avoids latency.

risks: Owner access only through Andrey and Pavel: approval latency could stall the weekly batch. Mitigation: a fixed Wednesday one-tap slot, defaults on every question, and a pre-approved queue of claim-free bodies (BLIND-01, CHECK-03 copy as written).
«Финальная распродажа» may signal closure. If so, warranty-based trust content is misleading. Mitigation: the Q2 gate pauses warranty lines and no «распродажа» wording is used until it is answered.

Production dependency (my judgment; the method doesn't cover it): the hero series needs someone who can play a short phrase. If nobody can, the fallback is the same sustained chord on every piano. That is weaker but still a fair A/B.

Fairness of the A/B: different presets, volume or speaker distance would be spotted by musicians and backfire. The editor logs preset, volume and the 20–30 cm distance, and the video gives no verdict and makes no claim that polyphony 192 sounds better.

Prices have a 7-day TTL and the stock moves. A stale price or a promoted SKU going out of stock breaks the truth gate. Mitigation: re-fetch before every publish, R9 swaps, and TIERS-07 and STAKES-11 stay blocked until the ledger has their prices.

Thin evidence: all insights are provisional with no chat data, and INS1 drives 3 of 8 portfolio ideas (37.5%, just under the 40% cap). The portfolio also lacks a true low-score wildcard because INS5 and INS9 are blocked by missing specs and prices. Mitigation: add the wildcard in week 2 and re-rank after the chat sample.
No TikTok account is confirmed, so the fastest test surface may be missing. Instagram and YouTube carry weeks 1–2, and the per-platform pooled medians are hypotheses until 10 posts.

refutations.target: CHECK-03 и STATUS-18: строка «Casio — сервис только в Алматы», которая крутится еженедельно
refutations.why_fails: Скрывать это нельзя, но и выносить в заголовок еженедельного ролика незачем. Casio — это PX-S1100, AP-300, PX-770 и AP-270, то есть большая часть моих приоритетных остатков. Мы сами будем отговаривать людей от того, что нужно продать, и ещё рассылать это существующим клиентам через Status. При этом в плане нет ни слова о том, как магазин решает вопрос гарантии: забираем ли мы инструмент и сами отправляем в Алматы.

refutations.target: BLIND-01 и STAKES-11: слепое сравнение звука на слабый телефон в 20–30 см от динамика
refutations.why_fails: Слабый микрофон телефона и сжатие звука в соцсетях почти уравняют пианино за 200 тыс. и за 2 млн. Самым честным ответом зрителя будет «не слышно». Значит, мы сами внушаем людям, что дорогие модели (Dexibell, Kurzweil, AP-300) — переплата, а музыканты в комментариях посмеются над качеством записи. Это бьёт и по выручке, и по репутации.
refutations.fix: Перед публикацией сделать тестовую запись и дать мне послушать. Если разницы не слышно, менять формат: не «слышно ли», а «что вы получаете» (клавиши, наушники, корпус, гарантия). STAKES-11 с разницей в 10 раз без моего одобрения не выпускать. Если линейный выход доступен, писать звук с него.

refutations.why_fails: В Казахстане пианино за 200 тыс.–2 млн ₸ покупают в рассрочку: Kaspi Red, 0-0-12 и тому подобное. В плане сказано «только способы оплаты Kaspi», а рассрочка упомянута лишь вскользь как вопрос для меня. Для дорогой покупки к Новому году это главный рычаг, и в списке вопросов ко мне его нет. Страх родителя «а вдруг бросит» тоже снимает рассрочка, а не формулировки об условиях возврата.
refutations.fix: Добавить в Q1 вопрос: «Есть ли рассрочка через Kaspi или банк? Если да, на каких условиях?» Если есть, во всех роликах о бюджете и подарках писать «от X ₸/мес» с точными условиями.

refutations.target: FIRSTYEAR-15: «Вернуть можно… только если инструментом не пользовались»
refutations.why_fails: Во входных данных условия сайта звучат как «14 дней, стоимость доставки в обе стороны удерживается». Слов «если не пользовались» среди собранных фактов нет, это пересказ. Кроме того, ролик, который отвечает на страх родителя фразой «вернуть почти нельзя», такой страх только усиливает.
refutations.fix: Если упоминать возврат, то дословно как на сайте и только после моего «да». Лучше заменить это на рассрочку или на предложение прийти и поиграть в зале.

refutations.target: Нагрузка на работника и съёмку на первой неделе
refutations.why_fails: За 17 минут нужно: восемь сцен, семь инструментов, на каждом выставить одинаковый тембр и громкость, по 2 дубля, кто-то должен сыграть фразу, переставить коробку и снять вход. Это нереально на одном слабом телефоне. При этом бюджет работника 20 минут в неделю, а он ещё каждую неделю отмечает коды. В итоге сорванная съёмка или нечестное сравнение.
refutations.fix: В первую съёмку взять только 2 пары и 3 вспомогательных кадра. Сначала узнать, кто в зале умеет играть, а не выяснять это в день съёмки.

refutations.why_fails: Ответ на Q1–Q3 нужен к 10.10 18:00, то есть через день, и через двух посредников. Без ответа план сам ставит цель «+10» и работает по ней.

refutations.why_fails: При 3 постах в неделю и нескольких кодах статистика будет шумом. Мне нужно знать одно: сколько пианино продано по кодам за неделю и какой ролик это дал. К тому же люди пишут в WhatsApp, не вводя код, и такие продажи потеряются.
refutations.fix: Отчёт в 3 строки: обращения о пианино (с кодом и без), продажи и время ответа. Продавцу дать вопрос «Откуда узнали?», а не полагаться только на коды.

output.persona: Short-form creator and SMM for local retail in Kazakhstan and the CIS, mostly Astana and Almaty shops selling expensive items through WhatsApp and Kaspi. I judge whether a plan can be filmed on one weak phone, whether people will share it locally, and whether it brings real inquiries, not just views.
output.best_idea: TIERS-07 (three budgets with the same phrase) is the best idea here. It answers the question parents in Astana actually ask: «сколько стоит нормальное пианино ребёнку в музыкалку». It is the only hero idea built on the high-stock models (Estrada EDP-220BK 9 units, PX-S1100 5, AP-300WE 4). It gets saved and forwarded to whoever pays, and its CTA ("send your budget") gives the seller something to answer. I would make it the lead series and run each tier as its own episode. The runner-up is the headphone-silence wildcard (INS5): «22:00, соседи, ребёнок занимается». Every Astana apartment family has this problem, and the phone mic can capture it because the payoff is silence, not tone.

refutations.target: Campaign SMP «Услышьте, за что платите больше» / hero series «Одна фраза» (BLIND-01, STAKES-11)
refutations.why_fails: The whole lead series depends on a sound difference reaching the viewer. It has to pass through a weak phone mic (automatic gain and noise suppression flatten piano decay), then Instagram/TikTok audio compression, then the viewer's phone speaker. The difference the video cites is polyphony 128 vs 192, which nobody can hear on a 4-second phrase. Most comments will say «одинаково». That pushes viewers toward the cheapest listing anywhere, including Kaspi, and does not make them think Muzzone is the place to choose. The message itself promises something the medium cannot deliver.
refutations.fix: Before committing the hero arm, do a 30-second test. Record the PX-770 and AP-270 phrase, upload it as a private Reel, and play it back on a cheap Android phone. If two people on staff can't tell the two apart, change the hero to differences the phone can show. Examples: the key action filmed close-up (hammer weight, a finger pressing and releasing), headphones plugged in followed by silence, a 3-pedal unit vs a single sustain pedal, the instrument's footprint in a typical Astana apartment corner, cabinet vs portable. Change the SMP to something like «Покажем, за что вы платите — до того, как заплатите».

refutations.target: Hero SKU choice (BLIND-01 and ANAT-02 use PX-770 vs AP-270; STAKES-11 uses a 2 M ₸ Dexibell)
refutations.why_fails: The business goal says to push models with 3 or more units in stock: EDP-220BK, PX-S1100, AP-300WE, Kurzweil CUP. Yet the first and most-reused video is built on two Casios with unknown stock, and STAKES-11 gives reach to a 2 M ₸ piano that nobody in this audience will buy. The best organic reach in week 1 goes to the wrong stock.
refutations.fix: Build week 1 on the high-stock models: EDP-220BK vs PX-S1100 (the budget question) and Kurzweil CUP E1 vs M1. Move PX-770 vs AP-270 to the YouTube search line, where it fits as a model-name query. Drop STAKES-11 or replace the Dexibell with the most expensive model that is actually in stock and sensibly priced.

refutations.target: Week 1 shoot «≤17 мин» (8 setups, 7 pianos, matched presets and volume, 2 takes each)
refutations.why_fails: It can't be done in 17 minutes. Seven instruments have to be found on the floor, powered on, set to the same preset and volume (each brand's menus are different), and played by someone who can repeat the phrase cleanly. The box also has to be brought out of the back room, and the worker has to go outside for the entrance shot. That is 40 to 60 minutes realistically, and the worker budget is 20 minutes a week including logging codes. The worker either skips shots or rushes them, and a rushed preset match ruins the 'fair test' premise that musicians will check.
refutations.fix: Limit each session to 2 pianos and 3 setups, at most 10 minutes. Write the preset name and volume as a printed checklist that stays taped to each piano. Plan four sessions across October instead of one big one. Cut the entrance shot and the box shot from week 1, since stock footage or AI covers can stand in for them.

refutations.why_fails: In Kazakhstan, a buyer spending 230 k to 750 k ₸ checks Kaspi.kz first and pays with Kaspi Red or an installment plan (0-0-12/24). The plan treats «Kaspi shop unknown» and installments as a side flag. FIRSTYEAR-15 answers «а если бросит?» with a return policy that only applies if the piano is unused, which helps nobody. Meanwhile the obvious local answer, spreading the cost to about 20 k ₸ a month, is not in the plan at all.

If the answer is no, say so in chat replies and drop the return-policy angle.

refutations.why_fails: Musicians who argue about sound in the comments are spread across the whole CIS and are not buying a starter piano in Astana. With 0 ₸ of paid promotion and an Instagram account nobody has looked at, A/B-listen videos that work will mostly bring non-local views and very few inquiries. The plan never names the real local channel: music-school teachers and the WhatsApp chats of each class's parents, where piano advice actually spreads.
refutations.fix: Add a teacher track. In week 1, the worker gives the store's card to 5 or 10 teachers at nearby music schools or ДМШ. Make TIERS-07 and CHECK-03 short and vertical enough to be forwarded straight into class parent chats. Put the location (Астана, Кажымукана 14) on screen in every video so local viewers know where the shop is.

refutations.why_fails: The checklist is a list of Muzzone's terms (no bench, service in Almaty, delivery), not an actual buyer's checklist, so it reads like a disclaimer. The shots are an empty floor, a lid closing and the shop entrance, which give nothing to stop on. Point 2 (service only in Almaty) will put off Astana buyers of Casio, the brand with the most stock.
refutations.fix: Rewrite it as a real check before buying: (1) Are the keys weighted hammer action? Show a finger pressing a key. (2) Are a stand and 3 pedals included? The PX-S1100 is portable, so check what comes with it and show it. (3) Is there a headphone output? Show headphones going in. Keep the warranty and Almaty disclosure in the trust highlights and in the WhatsApp reply, where full disclosure fits better than in a hook.

refutations.target: Hands only, no faces, AI voiceover (FIRSTYEAR-15, all series)

refutations.fix: In week 0, ask for one seller who will appear by voice only, recording on a phone held near the face. Move this from week 3 to week 1. If nobody agrees, use text with the instrument's own sound and no AI voiceover.

refutations.target: Attribution via code words (СЛЫШНО1 etc.) logged by the worker in 2 min/week
refutations.why_fails: Most people who write after a Reel won't type a code. They will say «здравствуйте, сколько стоит пианино из видео». Links in Reels aren't clickable, and sellers won't keep a weekly log while working. You will end up with 2 or 3 coded inquiries and a misleading 'content doesn't work' signal at the 22 November checkpoint.
refutations.fix: Use one prefilled wa.me link per platform in the bio and the pinned comment, and count every 'from video' message. Ask the seller to keep one habit: when a piano inquiry comes in, reply «Откуда о нас узнали?» and forward the chat to a single WhatsApp group. AI then does the counting each week.

refutations.why_fails: The joke works, but the payoff (a 3-day reserve, extendable) is weak and blocked behind Q3. If Q3 isn't answered, the only December conversion idea becomes empty filler.

Revision 2. Every listing in the category says «88 клавиш». In-stock prices run from 232 960 ₸ to 754 990 ₸ on the models we need to move. Buyers can't see what the extra money buys, and the old answer, «listen to the difference», does not survive a weak phone mic, platform compression and a phone speaker. So the hero no longer asks viewers to hear anything. It **shows the differences a phone camera captures reliably**:
- key travel when a finger presses and releases;
- what is on the floor (stand, 1 pedal or 3, a bench or none);
- headphones going in, then a silent room;
- the depth and look of the body (cabinet vs portable).

Each claim about a model is shown only once it is in that model's spec card in the ledger.

**Platform idea «Покажем до оплаты».**
- Device, frame 1 of every episode: top-down, two in-stock pianos side by side, one finger pressing the same key on each with the real key thud. On-screen question «[разница] — за что?», with no ₸ figure in the first 2 seconds (G4).
- Fixed end frame: «Астана, Кажымукана 14 · WhatsApp: слово ___».

- EDP-220BK vs Casio AP-300WE (4 units): more than 3× the price.
- PX-770 vs AP-270 (3 and 5 units) moves to the YouTube model-name search line. STAKES-11's 2 M ₸ Dexibell is dropped.

**Around the hero:**
- «Перед оплатой»: a real buyer's checklist covering keys, stand and pedals, and headphones.
- «Вопрос родителя»: honest answers, including a teacher-question episode.
- A December gift series.
- A local distribution track. Music-school teachers and class parent chats get a forwardable card with its own code.

**Conversion layer:** one WA code per video, a pinned «Как заказать пианино» video, WA Status for existing contacts, and instalment pricing («от X ₸/мес»). Instalment pricing is used only if the owner confirms the exact Kaspi or bank terms.

output.single_minded_message_ru: Покажем, за что вы платите, — до того, как заплатите.
output.why_this_wins:
This is not a forecast. Text judges are near chance on short-form (L001, ρ 0.07 for retail), so this is a better-built set of shots on goal. What changed, and why it is the better bet:

1. **The format can now keep its promise.** The hero shows key travel, pedals, stand, headphones and body depth. A weak phone films these reliably. A 4-second sound A/B through phone mic → compression → phone speaker would mostly get «одинаково» and push viewers to the cheapest listing anywhere. Sound comparison survives only as one exploration episode, and only if it passes a staff blind playback test on a cheap Android and the boss approves after listening.

2. **Reach goes to the stock that has to move.** Week 1 is Kurzweil CUP E1/M1 (3+3 units), week 2 is EDP-220BK (9) vs PX-S1100 (5), week 3 adds AP-300WE (4). Together these are 24 units in the first three weeks of hero content. Nothing promotes a 1-unit 2 M ₸ piano.

3. **We don't talk buyers out of our own Casio stock.** Casio's Almaty-only service stays fully disclosed in the WA reply, if asked, and on the trust highlight in exact site wording. It is no longer a hook line in a weekly Status. The warranty line in videos waits for the owner to confirm how the shop handles repairs.

4. **It uses the local buying lever.** Instalments («от X ₸/мес») are now owner question #1 in week 0. If they are confirmed, they reframe the budget, gift and «а если бросит?» videos. The return-policy angle that helped nobody is gone.

5. **Distribution is local, not CIS musicians.** A teacher track (ДМШ teachers → class parent chats, coded ПЕДАГОГ1/РОДИТЕЛИ1), forwardable vertical utility cuts, and the Astana address on every end frame point reach at buyers in Astana.

6. **The shoot is realistic.** Each session uses ≤2 pianos, ≤3 setups and ≤10 minutes, with a preset/volume/framing checklist taped to each piano. That is four small October sessions instead of one impossible 17-minute marathon.

7. **It fixes our known failure mode.** Demos are tied to a buyer's money question (L006), there are no price slides (L005), and a YouTube model-name search line reuses the footage (L002/L004) at zero extra minutes.

measurement.success_metric:
Business: digital pianos sold and attributed by 2026-12-31.

The target is assumed at +10 attributed sales ≈ 50 coded inquiries (assumed 20% inquiry-to-order rate). It is replaced by the owner's Q2 number and the chat-sample rate.

Thompson reward: E-score = √(rel_reach × rel_actions) at T+7d, scored as beating the median.
- YouTube is normalised against the channel's own median.
- Instagram and TikTok use the pooled music-retail median, a hypothesis until there are 10 posts per platform.
- The reward switches to coded piano WA inquiries per 1k reach at ≥10 coded inquiries in a rolling 4 weeks.

Tail: ≥1 post at ≥5× the median by 20 Dec (likely, not guaranteed).
measurement.attribution:
1. One WA code per video and per platform variant: ВЫБОР1, ПРОВЕРКА1, ПЕДАГОГ1, ПЕРВЫЙ1, СЕМЬЯ1, РАЗНИЦА1, БЮДЖЕТ1, ЗАЧТО1, ПОДАРОК1, with new codes per episode. The teacher/parent card has its own code, РОДИТЕЛИ1, so the local track is measured separately.
2. The WA logger records code → model → city → instalment asked Y/N → sold Y/N, weekly (daily in the push).
3. Weak signals: promoted vs unpromoted piano SKU stock_qty on the site (difference-in-differences), plus Kaspi SKU lift if a Kaspi shop is confirmed.
4. Uncoded inquiries are logged «без кода» and never claimed.

decision_rules: Mix: 50/35/15 (hero / proof+utility / conversion) to 20 Dec with exploration ≥25%; 30/30/40 on 21–31 Dec with exploration ≥15%.

SKU priority rule. Hero and utility slots go to SKUs with ≥3 units on the site, re-read weekly: EDP-220BK, PX-S1100, AP-300WE, CUP E1/M1, and PX-770/AP-270 on the YouTube line. A 1-unit SKU never gets a hero slot. If a priority SKU drops below 2, its slots move to the next most-stocked in-stock model.

Show-not-hear rule. Hero episodes argue only with visible, ledger-backed differences. A sound A/B may run only as one exploration slot, and only if two staff told the pianos apart on a cheap Android in the week-0 test and the boss approved after listening. Line-out recording is used only with a cable the shop already has. A 10× sound comparison never runs.
G4 tightening (my call, beyond the slate): no ₸ figure in the first 2 seconds of any video. Prices and gaps appear from 2 s onward, inside the story.

Casio service disclosure rule. Full disclosure (2-year warranty, service in Almaty) goes in the WA reply when asked and on the trust highlight in exact site wording. It is never in a hook or a recurring Status. In videos the warranty line is «гарантия 2 года, по гарантийному случаю — [как магазин организует ремонт]», published only after the owner confirms the procedure. It is never hidden.

Instalment gate (Q1). If instalments are confirmed, «от X ₸/мес» goes into TIERS-07, GIFT-05 and FIRSTYEAR-15 with the provider and exact terms, owner sign-off on every post, and no «0%» unless confirmed. If they are not confirmed, no monthly figures appear anywhere, and FIRSTYEAR-15 runs the entry-tier version.

Local rule. Every video ends on «Астана, Кажымукана 14 · WhatsApp: слово ___» with an Instagram location tag. If coded inquiries from outside Astana exceed 50% without sales, CTAs are re-weighted toward the free RK delivery fact.

Shoot rule. Each weekly session uses ≤2 pianos and ≤3 setups and takes ≤10 minutes, with the printed preset/volume/framing checklist taped to each piano. A shot that is skipped is replaced by reuse, never by AI depicting the product.
R1 Rescue at T+48h: rel_hold3 < 0.7 → re-cut with the next hook variant and repost ≥72 h later, once. If hold is fine but completion < 0.7, bring the payoff forward next time.
R2 Iterate on any post at ≥2× the median: a new pair on the same device, the same insight on a new engine, and an E19 reply.
R3 Scale on a post at ≥3× the median with ≥1 code: pin it, add it to Status and the teacher card. Paid only if approved.

R4 Allocate every Monday across A1 hero, A2 utility, A3 parent/teacher question and A4 gift (from 1 Dec) by 1 000 Thompson draws. Exploration ≥25%, cap 50% per arm, ≥1 slot every 2 weeks until 6 posts.
R5 Retire an arm if P(success rate > 0.5) < 0.15 after ≥8 posts.
R6 Report honestly: P(beats median) plus an 80% interval, «пока похоже, что…».
R7 Funnel check every 2 weeks: if E is rising but codes are flat, fix the CTA, the codes, reply time, the pinned video and the instalment info before making more content.
R8 Rethink: no arm at P > 0.6 and fewer than 10 codes by 22 Nov → rerun C with the chats and micro-voice, and propose a non-discount offer.
R9 Stock: re-check on publish day. A promoted SKU at 0 has its posts pulled and swapped. Never promote out-of-stock SKUs.

Truth gates: every price or gap literal is re-fetched within 7 days before publishing. Spec claims are made only from fetched spec cards. CHECK-03's generic checks are worded and approved by the store.
Q2 gate: until it is answered, no «распродажа» and no deadlines. If the store is closing, all warranty and after-sales lines pause.
Q3 gate: no «до 31-го» or «успеем к Новому году» without owner cut-offs.
CTA gate: «покажем рядом / приходите» CTAs only if the owner confirms showroom try-out. Otherwise the CTA is «пришлём, чем отличаются эти модели».
learning_questions: Does showing the difference (key action, pedals, stand, headphones, body) earn more saves and codes than reading it from spec cards? And does a sound A/B, if it passes the gate, add anything beyond that?
Does instalment framing («от X ₸/мес») raise coded inquiries and the inquiry-to-order rate on 230k–755k ₸ models, compared with full-price framing?
Does the teacher/parent-chat track (РОДИТЕЛИ1, ПЕДАГОГ1) produce more Astana inquiries per minute of effort than feed reach?
Which hero pair converts: same price / different piano (CUP E1 vs M1), the budget step (EDP-220BK vs PX-S1100), or the 3× gap (EDP-220BK vs AP-300WE)? Do sales follow stock depth?

Which tension actually moves Astana buyers: price vs what you get (INS1), the child quitting (INS4), spec confusion (INS3), the teacher's opinion (INS7) or the gift moment (INS2)? This decides the SMP lock on 22 Nov.
Is the bottleneck consideration, or conversion (chats dying at price or instalments, slow replies)?
What share of coded inquiries come from Astana vs regions, and does free RK delivery convert regional buyers?
Do teacher comments under TEACH-09 give material for E19 replies that outperform the originals?
